defense_contracts.raw_text: Enlighten IT Consulting LLC, Columbia, Maryland, has been awarded a $332,830,519 firm-fixed-price contract under a Commercial Solutions Opening via the Tradewinds Solutions Marketplace (TSM). This contract provides for an enterprise service solution that is critical in establishing interoperability with Joint Cyber Warfighting Architecture Common Runtime Stack for Data edge analytics, storage, and data transport capabilities within the Integrated Defensive Cyber System architecture. Work will be performed within and outside the continental United States and is expected to be completed by Sept. 30, 2032. This contract was a competitive acquisition via the TSM, and seven offers were received. Fiscal 2026 Air Force operations and maintenance funds; Air Force research, development, test and evaluation funds; Space Force research, development, test and evaluation funds; and Space Force operations and maintenance funds, are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Joint Base San Antonio, Texas, is the contracting activity (FA8307-26-C-B015). (Awarded on Sept. 30, 2026).
